text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Council for Youth and the Future to hold seminar in central city of Meknes on "Morocco of changes, choices for the future" on February 26 and 27.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri presides over board meeting of local councils' equipment fund.
- Morocco sells its image as emerging country for investment during Euromoney forum which was attended by more than 300 foreign businessmen.
- Controversy fuelled by opposition parties and General Confederation of Businessmen (CGEM) over takeover by French Lyonnaise des Eaux of Casablanca water and electricity distribution.

- Representatives of the United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) for Middle East and North Africa met in Marrakesh to devise new strategy for the region, focused on education of young women and maternal mortality.

- Palestinian Authority President Yasser Arafat expected in Rabat to prepare counter offensive against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's plans to establish new jewish settlements in East Jerusalem.
